unit_note: Rear Admiral John L. Hall's Assault Force O for Omaha Beach, with V Corps embarked (Maj. Gen. L. T. Gerow; landing force Maj. Gen. C. R. Huebner: 16th RCT of the 1st Division, 115th and 116th RCTs of the 29th, 2nd and 5th Ranger Battalions). Amphibious Force Flagship Ancon (Cdr. M. G. Pearson), assigned to this record directly. Task groups with warships: 124.6 Escort Group (US-TG-124-6, Capt. Harry Sanders) and 124.9 Bombardment Group (US-TG-124-9, Rear Admiral C. F. Bryant). Not in chunk 1: landing force 124.1, shore party 124.2, assault groups 124.3-124.5 (O-1 to O-3) and O-4 (Pointe du Hoc), gunfire support craft 124.8, sweeper group 124.10 (Cdr. J. S.
